problem_statement: The reagents table has several rows for the same chemical, one per lot. Deduplicate it in place by CAS number: for each chemical with more than one row, merge its lots into the row with the largest quantity (add the other lots' quantities to it and list the merged lot ids in its notes), then delete the rows you merged. Change the reagents table itself.
